acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a kitchen remodel in Pacifica or Daly City varies widely, generally ranging from $30,000 for a minor renovation to over $100,000 for a high-end, custom project. Factors influencing cost include the size of the kitchen, quality of materials, extent of structural changes, and appliance selections. A detailed estimate will be provided after an initial consultation and design planning, ensuring transparency in all expenses.
